d:
Watch the energetic “Junction Lo” video song from the Telugu movie Aagadu, featuring Mahesh Babu, Shruti Haasan and Tamannaah Bhatia. The song is composed by the talented Thaman S.
Movie Details:
Movie: Aagadu
Starring: Super Star Mahesh Babu, Tamannaah Bhatia, Sonu Sood, Brahmanandam, Rajendra Prasad
Music Director: S. Thaman
Director: Sreenu Vaitla
Producer: 14 Reels Entertainment
Music Label: Lahari Music
